acceptance_criteria.statement: Implement context trust classification and firewall has executable implementation and behavior-specific automated verification.
Repository traceability, upstream-adoption truth, schemas, migrations, evidence, and permanent safeguards remain consistent.

definition_of_done: Implementation is present and locally behaviorally verified.
Upstream integration claims match real integration paths.
Unavailable live external behavior remains explicitly unverified.
description: Implement context trust classification and firewall. This Pass 12 task converts source-grounded Context requirements into executable, locally verified implementation while retaining truthful external qualification state.
exclusions: No raw secret values in context packs or durable context evidence.
No optional upstream runtime is represented as live-qualified solely because an adapter exists.
objective: Implement context trust classification and firewall
observability_impact: Context pack identity, coverage, trust distribution, staleness, redactions, omissions, and receipts are machine-readable.
rationale: Context is an execution-control input. The implementation must remain minimal, source-grounded, revision-aware, policy-bounded, and traceable before delegated work can rely on it.
rollback_recovery_consideration: Immutable packs are never edited in place; revert the implementation/configuration or recompile a new pack from authoritative inputs while preserving prior receipts and evidence.
security_impact: Context policy controls trust, secret handling, provider egress, untrusted instructions, prompt-injection quarantine, and optional upstream boundaries.
title: Implement context trust classification and firewall
